candidate_en: Only Allah fears the knowledgeable among His servants. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.
Only those fear Allah, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.
This is the Book, beyond doubt, a guidance for the mindful.
O you who believe, support Allah and He will support you and make your feet firm.
